steps.why: Attach the fixture devices to the HTTP-created zone and configure a second hardware generation without calling ChirpStack provisioning.
Review fixture data for the paired parity probe.
steps.sql: UPDATE valve_settings SET last_clock_sync_queued_at=strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'); INSERT INTO valve_settings(device_eui,last_clock_sync_queued_at) SELECT deveui,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') FROM devices WHERE type_id='STREGA_VALVE' AND deveui NOT IN (SELECT device_eui FROM valve_settings)

steps.why: Mirror a role change while the bearer token is still valid.
steps.sql: UPDATE users SET role='viewer' WHERE id=1

steps.why: Restore the original actor before the plan cases.
steps.sql: UPDATE users SET role='admin' WHERE id=1

steps.why: Mirror the cloud account disabling the current bearer.
steps.sql: UPDATE users SET disabled_at='2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' WHERE id=1

steps.why: Restore the account for later plan tests.
steps.sql: UPDATE users SET disabled_at=NULL WHERE id=1

steps.why: Remove the valve from the actor’s zone while it remains unclaimed.
steps.sql: UPDATE devices SET irrigation_zone_id=NULL WHERE deveui='A840410000000006'

steps.why: Restore the valve’s zone before programming it.
steps.sql: UPDATE devices SET irrigation_zone_id=1 WHERE deveui='A840410000000006'

steps.why: Assign a valve to another local user who shares the same zone.
steps.sql: UPDATE devices SET user_id=2 WHERE deveui='A840410000000006'

steps.why: Restore the valve to the scenario actor.
steps.sql: UPDATE devices SET user_id=1 WHERE deveui='A840410000000006'

steps.why: Review fixture data for the paired parity probe.
steps.sql: UPDATE app_settings SET value=json_set(value,'$.edited_at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-31 seconds')) WHERE key LIKE 'valve_snapshot_pending:%'

steps.why: Advance the fixed snapshot past debounce without sleeping.
steps.sql: UPDATE app_settings SET value=json_set(value,'$.edited_at',strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now','-31 seconds')) WHERE key LIKE 'valve_snapshot_pending:%'

steps.why: Import an overlapping weekly row to exercise validation before any resend flush.
steps.sql: INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,label,weekdays_mask,start_time,duration_minutes,timezone) VALUES ('synthetic-resend-overlap','A840410000000006','WEEKLY','Imported overlap',127,'19:20',30,'UTC')

steps.why: Remove the synthetic overlap before the next case.
steps.sql: DELETE FROM valve_schedules WHERE schedule_uuid='synthetic-resend-overlap'

steps.why: Bind a conditional weekly schedule to a valve with no fixed plan.
steps.sql: INSERT INTO irrigation_policies(policy_uuid,zone_uuid,condition_json,timezone) SELECT 'synthetic-resend-policy',zone_uuid,'{}','UTC' FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id=1; INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,weekdays_mask,start_time,duration_minutes,timezone,condition_policy_uuid) VALUES ('synthetic-resend-conditional','A840410000000008','WEEKLY',1,'07:00',10,'UTC','synthetic-resend-policy')

steps.why: Add a fixed weekly schedule beside the conditional schedule.
steps.sql: INSERT INTO valve_schedules(schedule_uuid,device_eui,kind,weekdays_mask,start_time,duration_minutes,timezone) VALUES ('synthetic-resend-fixed','A840410000000008','WEEKLY',2,'07:00',10,'UTC')

steps.why: Retire the policy while the valve schedule still references it.
steps.sql: DELETE FROM valve_schedules WHERE schedule_uuid='synthetic-resend-fixed'; UPDATE irrigation_policies SET deleted_at='2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' WHERE policy_uuid='synthetic-resend-policy'

steps.why: Restore the conditional binding, then prepare a lifecycle clear through the legacy route.
steps.sql: UPDATE irrigation_policies SET deleted_at=NULL WHERE policy_uuid='synthetic-resend-policy'

steps.why: Pause skips unattempted occurrences and preserves in-flight history.
steps.sql:
INSERT INTO irrigation_occurrences(schedule_uuid,local_date,local_time,policy_uuid,zone_uuid,device_eui,due_at,state)
    SELECT 'synthetic-resend-conditional','2020-01-01','07:00',policy_uuid,zone_uuid,'A840410000000008','2020-01-01T07:00:00.000Z','PENDING' FROM irrigation_policies WHERE policy_uuid='synthetic-resend-policy'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'synthetic-resend-conditional','2020-01-02','07:00',policy_uuid,zone_uuid,'A840410000000008','2020-01-02T07:00:00.000Z','CLAIMED' FROM irrigation_policies WHERE policy_uuid='synthetic-resend-policy'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'synthetic-resend-conditional','2020-01-03','07:00',policy_uuid,zone_uuid,'A840410000000008','2020-01-03T07:00:00.000Z','SENT' FROM irrigation_policies WHERE policy_uuid='synthetic-resend-policy'

steps.why: Supply the durable result of one rejected enqueue on the new clear revision.
steps.sql: UPDATE valve_schedule_pushes SET transport_json=json_set(transport_json,'$.phase','enqueue_rejected') WHERE push_id=(SELECT json_extract(conditional_control_json,'$.required_push_ids[0]') FROM valve_settings WHERE device_eui='A840410000000008')

steps.why: Change the zone version so the stored clear is obsolete.
steps.sql: UPDATE irrigation_zones SET sync_version=sync_version+1 WHERE id=1
